body:
## Objective

Make the documented V8-next development environment deterministic for the DuckDB integration test.

## Owning authority

- v8-next pyproject.toml and uv.lock
- Test suite contract for v8-next/tests/test_store_models_and_duckdb.py

## Change class

DEFECT_FIX

## Current state / Observed defect

The full command:

    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev pytest -q v8-next/tests

produced 722 passed and 1 failed. The failure is:

    v8-next/tests/test_store_models_and_duckdb.py::test_duckdb_olap_integration
    ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'duckdb'

The test is present but the documented dev environment does not provide the import.

## Required end state

Choose and document one explicit contract:

1. Add a pinned, compatible DuckDB dependency to the appropriate locked extra and keep the integration test required; or
2. Make the test an explicit, justified optional integration test with a clear skip/preflight contract.

The default documented verification path must not fail because the dependency contract is ambiguous.

## Expected file / module surface

- v8-next/pyproject.toml
- v8-next/uv.lock
- v8-next/tests/test_store_models_and_duckdb.py
- v8-next README/developer verification instructions if needed

## Verification gates

    uv sync --project v8-next --locked --extra dev
    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev python -c "import duckdb"
    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev pytest -q v8-next/tests/test_store_models_and_duckdb.py

## Required evidence artifacts

- Locked dependency diff
- Test output showing the chosen contract is satisfied
- No hidden local-only dependency

## Non-goals / forbidden scope

- Do not silently skip the test.
- Do not add an unpinned dependency.
- Do not replace DuckDB behavior with a fake or synthetic store.
- Do not weaken economic/evidence assertions.

## Requirements

- R1: The dependency/test contract is explicit.
- R2: A clean locked environment reproduces the result.
- R3: The full test command has a documented outcome.

## Base SHA

1563d8955c6e9c47e3909037cdcdeb5961ffc800

## Evidence

PENDING
title: [DEFECT] V8-next test environment lacks locked DuckDB dependency
